foundation: table_IIa: RI=U/N, one full load and U served vectors
case_id: model_id/workload/exact_sweep_integer; infinity suffix for symbolic QKV limit
unused_sweep: U or L not used by this workload is null
exact_values: integers or {numerator,denominator}; infinity is string; no binary float counts
limit_rule: QKV U=infinity: Q_S/RI/shared overlap grow without bound, Q_R and resident state remain finite; kind=limit; do not subtract infinities
csv_aggregate: component=total; N,K,state_copies blank; components leave shared_input_removed_Byte blank
sources_format: list of {path,sha256,locator}; paths relative task root, archived paths may use ../archived/task2_table_IIb_previous/...
legacy_regression: FFN compares against archived operator scaled by U/old_B; Attention legacy cases independently rechecked, 12 current 1K cases overlap; QKV U=1 changed-window comparison

container_types.config.models: list in model_order; each model uses the exact config_model_keys below
container_types.config.sweeps: object keyed by workload id; value is {U:[...]} or {L:[...]}
container_types.config.window_rules: object keyed by workload id; each value uses window_keys below
container_types.case.parameters: object of named native scalar dimensions; values retain exact types
container_types.case.window: object using the exact window_keys below
container_types.results.cases: list in model order, then workload order, then sweep order
container_types.case.components: list in the exact semantic order given above
container_types.checks: object with the exact checks_root_keys below

window_field_types: all three window fields are concise strings; numeric U/L and demand fields carry actual values
reuse_definition: U: reuse count, cumulative input vectors served after one complete weight load, including the first use; may span batches/requests

display.RI: RI >= 1: one decimal place; 0 < RI < 1: three significant digits, fixed decimal notation; ROUND_HALF_UP
